root_cause: Nuitka included pydicom Python modules but omitted pydicom package data, causing FileNotFoundError for data/urls.json during packaged startup.
changes: Added --include-package-data=pydicom to all included GitHub Nuitka workflows
Added post-build validation requiring *urls.json in Nuitka output
Preserved Commit0080 lazy decoder architecture and GDCM-free startup
